We are able to perfectly replicate the Conley standard errors

targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
The Poisson regression approach does not alter the results, but in

          less conclusive and lose statistical significance.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Reported numbers recovered using supplied version of the ado file; additional state-level trends weaken central labor-allocation findings. Raw-source reconstruction difficulties do not change successful computational reproduction from supplied data.
